mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (recipient_id, sender_id, type, post_id, comment_id, content, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{postId}, #{commentId}, #{content}, 0, NOW())

INSERT IGNORE INTO notification (recipient_id, sender_id, type, post_id, comment_id, content, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{postId}, #{commentId}, #{content}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.type, n.post_id, n.comment_id, n.content, n.is_read, n.created_at, n.sender_id, u.name AS sender_name, u.avatar AS sender_avatar FROM notification n LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = n.sender_id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{recipientId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND recipient_id = #{recipientId}
UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = 0
